name: @pipeworx/mcp-sfda-drugs

tools.name: sfda_drug_search
tools.description: Search Saudi Arabia registered human drugs with official SFDA prices in SAR. Scans the SFDA registered-drugs price list (sourced from www.sfda.gov.sa/en/drugs-list, ~14,000+ drugs across ~1,400 pages of 15-20 rows) and filters rows locally by scientific (generic) or trade name, because the SFDA site currently ignores its own search parameters. A single call scans a bounded window of pages, so to search the whole list keep calling with the returned next_page until done:true or you have enough matches. Omit query to simply browse pages in order. Each row carries a details ref for sfda_drug_details.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against scientific name AND trade name (e.g. "metformin", "panadol"). Omit to list rows unfiltered.

start_page.description: Zero-indexed page of the SFDA list to start scanning from. Default 0.

pages_to_scan.description: How many consecutive pages to scan in this call (1-30). Default 10.

tools.name: sfda_drug_details
tools.description: Full SFDA record for one entry from a list returned by sfda_drug_search or sfda_drug_shortages — registration number, trade/scientific name, price, and every other field the SFDA details page shows. Sourced from www.sfda.gov.sa details_data pages. Pass the nid and id from a row's details ref.

nid.description: List node id from the details ref (e.g. "17582" for the drugs list).

id.description: Row id from the details ref (numeric for drugs, a generic-name string for shortages).

tools.name: sfda_drug_shortages
tools.description: Current drug shortages in Saudi Arabia, sourced from the SFDA shortage list (www.sfda.gov.sa/en/currentlyInShortageList): generic name, availability status, and how many trade-name products are affected. Filters are applied by the SFDA server. Arabic status values are translated to English (original kept in status_ar).

scientific_name.description: Filter by generic/scientific name substring, e.g. "AMOXICILLIN".

page.description: Page number, zero-indexed (each page has 10-20 rows). Default 0.

tools.name: sfda_drug_approvals
tools.description: Recent SFDA drug approvals in Saudi Arabia (sourced from www.sfda.gov.sa/en/new-sfda-drug-approvals): request type, drug type, trade name, scientific name, strength, dosage form, approval date. Newest first. Note: the SFDA leaves approval_date blank on the newest rows for a while — an empty date means SFDA has not published it yet, not a missing drug.

scientific_name.description: Filter by scientific (generic) name substring, e.g. "semaglutide".

page.description: Page number, zero-indexed (each page has 10-20 rows). Default 0.

tools.name: sfda_clinical_trials
tools.description: Clinical trials registered with the SFDA and running in Saudi Arabia (sourced from www.sfda.gov.sa/en/drug_clinical_trials_list): study title, sponsor, status, study drug, phase, protocol number, and trial site (hospital). Filters are applied by the SFDA server.

drug.description: Filter by study drug name substring, e.g. "VX 880".

site.description: Filter by trial site (hospital/city) substring, e.g. "Riyadh".

page.description: Page number, zero-indexed (each page has 10-20 rows). Default 0.

tools.name: sfda_drug_companies
tools.description: Drug companies and manufacturing sites registered with the SFDA (sourced from www.sfda.gov.sa/en/drug-companies): company name, address, registration status and number, certificate issue date (Hijri calendar), drug type, production line, and country. Filters are applied by the SFDA server. Arabic enum values are translated to English (originals kept in *_ar fields).

name.description: Filter by company name (English) substring, e.g. "BAYER".

registration_no.description: Filter by company registration number, e.g. "1978/2".

production_line.description: Filter by production line substring, e.g. "TABLET".

country.description: Filter by country name in Arabic as SFDA stores it (e.g. "فرنسا" for France). English values do not match.

page.description: Page number, zero-indexed (each page has 10-20 rows). Default 0.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-sfda-drugs forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the sfda-drugs pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
